AI Agent Definition & Usage: Formation the user has selected for thier team. Either 4-4-2 or 4-3-3.
Unique identifier for the player. Use this as the primary key to join with statistical and fixture tables.
The player's designated field position (e.g., Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder, Striker). Use this to enforce valid lineup formation constraints.
The current real-world team the player plays for. Use this to map the player to upcoming fixtures (Step 2) and team statistics (Steps 4 & 5).
Unique identifier for the Home team.
Unique identifier for the Away team.
Current injury status. Constraint: If true/injured, the AI must exclude the player from the recommended starting lineup.
Unique identifier for the player's team.
Total matches started. Compare with appearances to assess rotation risk (high lineups = guaranteed starter).
Average match rating. Use as a baseline form indicator.
Total shots taken. High volume indicates strong goal-scoring potential.
Shots on target. High ratio of shots_on to shots_total indicates clinical finishing.
Total goals scored. Highest weighted offensive metric.
Total assists. Assists don't count towards fantasy points in our scoring system.
Successful dribbles. High success indicates a highly involved attacking player.
Times fouled. Indicates a player who wins free kicks/penalties.
Average goals conceded at home. Use to evaluate defenders when playing at home.
Average goals conceded away. Use to evaluate defenders when playing away.
Overall average goals conceded per game. Lower is better for defensive assets.
Total clean sheets at home. High value directly correlates to the likely amount of goals home defenders will concede.
Total clean sheets at home. High value directly correlates to the likely amount of goals away defenders will concede.
Total goals scored at home. High value boosts home attackers.
Total goals scored away. High value boosts away attackers.
Overall average goals scored per game.
Times team scored 0 goals at home. High value indicates high risk for attackers in home fixtures.
Times team scored 0 goals away. High value indicates high risk for attackers in away fixtures.
Total goals conceded while on pitch. Lower is better.
Duels successfully won. Combine with duels_total for win percentage. High win rates indicate reliable defenders.
Total matches started. Crucial for GKs as they rarely substitute.
Total goals conceded. Negative scoring impact.
Current availability. Hard Constraint: AI must not recommend players flagged as injured where value is set to true.
Primary key for the standings record.
Current league position (1st, 2nd, etc.). AI should use this to gauge overall team strength and fixture difficulty for matchups.
Unique identifier for the team. Use to join with fixtures, player and team statistics.
Total league points accumulated. A primary indicator of team success and momentum.
Goal difference (Goals For minus Goals Against).
String representation of recent match results (e.g., 'WWLDW'). AI should use this to identify teams and players on hot or cold streaks.
Total matches played in the league.
Total goals scored by the team. Identifies high-scoring teams whose midfielder and striker players should be favored.
Total goals conceded by the team. Identifies defensively vulnerable teams to target when picking midfielders and strikers.
System timestamp for when the record was created.
